name: qfd_vm_rowrd_t-rr1-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen TP8 VM region row-read leaf (one per region): 16 FSW-32 slices, 4:1 one-hot AND-OR x 2 into t1, 2:1 into ro; 1,664 flops, one root. PIN-BOUND outline: bx is 4,096 pins = 393 um of one M5 face. Bench = region-leaf miter vs the flat ot_qfd_vm_region_quarter + the rowrd mutant.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_vm_rowrd_t u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_region_leaf.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: rl_ok
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && $HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator --binary --timing -O1 --output-split 20000 --output-split-cfuncs 2000 -Wno-fatal -Wno-WIDTH -Wno-UNUSED -Wno-PINMISSING -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-LATCH -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-BLKSEQ -Wno-UNOPTFLAT -CFLAGS -O0 -j 2 --top-module tb_qfd_vm_region_leaf -GSEED=1 --Mdir {RUN}/bench/rl_ok rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/tb_qfd_vm_region_leaf.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_region_leaf.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_die_split_20261012/ot_qfd_vm_region_quarter.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_die_split_20261012/ot_qfd_vm_answer_tiles.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_die_split_20261012/ot_qfd_vm_xfifo8_t.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_me_20261008/ot_qfd_sp_vector_memory_bv.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xplane.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_me_20261008/ot_qfd_res_path.sv rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_sp_vector_memory.sv rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_sp_tree_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_tree_delay.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_tree_delay_tiles.sv > {RUN}/bench/rl_ok.build.log 2>&1 && {RUN}/bench/rl_ok/Vtb_qfd_vm_region_leaf > {RUN}/bench/rl_ok.log 2>&1; tail -3 {RUN}/bench/rl_ok.log; grep -q '^PASS qfd_vm_region_leaf' {RUN}/bench/rl_ok.log

bench.name: rl_mut1
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && $HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator --binary --timing -O1 --output-split 20000 --output-split-cfuncs 2000 -Wno-fatal -Wno-WIDTH -Wno-UNUSED -Wno-PINMISSING -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-LATCH -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-BLKSEQ -Wno-UNOPTFLAT -CFLAGS -O0 -j 2 --top-module tb_qfd_vm_region_leaf -GLEAF_MUT=1 --Mdir {RUN}/bench/rl_mut1 rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/tb_qfd_vm_region_leaf.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_region_leaf.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_die_split_20261012/ot_qfd_vm_region_quarter.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_die_split_20261012/ot_qfd_vm_answer_tiles.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_die_split_20261012/ot_qfd_vm_xfifo8_t.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_me_20261008/ot_qfd_sp_vector_memory_bv.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xplane.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_me_20261008/ot_qfd_res_path.sv rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_sp_vector_memory.sv rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_sp_tree_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_tree_delay.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_tree_delay_tiles.sv > {RUN}/bench/rl_mut1.build.log 2>&1 && {RUN}/bench/rl_mut1/Vtb_qfd_vm_region_leaf > {RUN}/bench/rl_mut1.log 2>&1; tail -3 {RUN}/bench/rl_mut1.log; grep -q '^PASS qfd_vm_region_leaf' {RUN}/bench/rl_mut1.log
